top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength optical lattice clock is a distinct, experimentally mature invention, reproduced independently by several laboratories at the 1e-18 level, with a clean two-name allocation (Katori, Ye) and a citation that can be scoped to the lattice rather than to atomic clocks in general. P002 is a deeper conceptual idea but has contested credit (BHZ, 3D work, Hasan, Fu, Moore) and overlap with the 2016 prize, so it ranks second; no award is the least preferred since a mature, uncontested achievement exists.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; general atomic-physics and precision-spectroscopy closeness (Svanberg and Hall lab ties) is not a specific conflict with Katori or Ye
